description: This file defines SwiftUI views and helper classes for previewing session messages in a macOS application, including caching, limiting concurrent previews, and fetching session data asynchronously.

classes.name: SessionPreviewItem
classes.description: Represents a preview item with an identifier, role, and text content.

classes.name: PreviewRole
classes.description: Enumerates the roles of participants in the session preview such as user, assistant, tool, system, or other, with a label property for display.

classes.name: SessionPreviewCache
classes.description: Handles caching of session preview snapshots with singleton shared instance.

classes.name: SessionPreviewLimiter
classes.description: Controls concurrent access to session preview requests with singleton shared instance.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewSnapshot
classes.description: Data structure holding the items and status of a session preview.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view component for displaying session message previews with various loading states.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewLoader
classes.description: Provides static methods for prewarming, loading, and fetching session previews asynchronously, including error handling and caching logic.

methods.name: cachedSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a cached snapshot if it exists and is still valid.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores a snapshot in cache for a given session key.

methods.name: lastSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves the last snapshot stored in cache without age validation.

methods.name: withPermit
methods.description: Manages permit acquisition for concurrent session preview requests.

methods.name: _testSet
methods.description: Test utility to manually set cache entries.

methods.name: _testReset
methods.description: Test utility to clear cache entries.
